sourceTransforms.reason: Case-insensitive keyword tokens end before identifier continuation characters, matching the source word lexer rather than consuming a prefix of a longer identifier.
Prefer the complete IS NOT operator to IS with a negated right operand, preserving both operator productions and their fields.
The named statement alias surrounds the complete read or write production in a common table expression, retaining its selected clause as a child.

Source, filter, grouping, ordering, set-operation and join keywords begin their following clauses instead of becoming an optional implicit alias. Quoted identifiers and longer words retain their original alternatives.
When a literal is absent, prefer the named NULL recovery marker over an anonymous regular-expression token; every accepted literal production and its concrete kind remains available.
